expectedCorrelations.description: Concurrent clients rise in stages from 12 to 180; CPU follows the prior 15-minute load sample with bounded variation, while heap pressure accumulates.
The overload interval contains a denser warning/error sequence and an existing multiline stack sentinel. These co-occurring signals identify a useful inspection window without asserting cause.

Heap drops sharply at the declared major-GC sample, then clients and CPU fall as the load stage ends; warning/error prevalence returns toward baseline. The fixture asserts correlation only, not causation.

incidentWindow.description: The staged client ramp reaches overload while CPU and heap pressure rise and warning/error logs become more frequent; the aligned signals are evidence for investigation, not proof of causation.
